subject: spanish
title: Stamp 3: Franco's Victory and Dictatorship
welcome_lead: Stamp Franco's victory in 1939 and the decades that followed.
meta_desc: A-Level Spanish adventure on Franco's victory, the dictatorship 1939-1975, and historical memory.

concepts.def: Caudillo of Spain 1939-1975; led Nationalists and ruled dictatorship.
End of the war on 1 April 1939 with the Nationalists' victory.
Valley of the Fallen; monumental mausoleum where Franco was buried 1975-2019.
Historical Memory Law 2007 (and Democratic Memory Law 2022) recognising victims.
Single legal political organisation under Francoism.

walkthroughs.body_html: After the fall of Madrid in March 1939, Franco proclaimed victory on 1 April. Hundreds of thousands of Republicans went into exile. Mass repression marked the early postwar years.

Francoism aligned with Axis powers initially but stayed neutral in WWII. From the 1950s, Cold War pragmatism brought US bases (1953) and entry into the UN (1955). Tourism boom and technocratic 'desarrollismo' followed.

The 1977 Pact of Forgetting deferred public reckoning. The 2007 Memory Law began identifying victims. In 2019, Franco was exhumed from the Valley of the Fallen. The 2022 Democratic Memory Law deepened the policy.
